messages:
jordan: T-minus 60m for the EU cutover — running the calm-before-cutover checklist. Freeze is in effect for the services in the release plan. tagging owners: @alex @kat @maria. Key items: pin artifact, canary windows, DB migration read-only flag, webhook consumer backoff. ack + any last-minute blockers?

alex: ACK. I confirmed migrations are staged and reversible. no schema changes that require downtime.

kat: ACK. Release notes uploaded to the docs bucket, link: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/3.8.0 — added consumer-side retry guidance.

maria: quick Q — what's our rollback threshold? error-rate or latency? need to call out the numbers for oncall to act.

sam: will run the pin now and start a small canary. deploy-bot: please pin and start canary (10%).

deploy-bot: /pin artifact v3.8.0 -> scope=canary,owners=[sam,jordan]
deploy-bot: PIN APPLIED: artifact v3.8.0 pinned for canary (lock id: lock-20260321-1738)

deploy-bot: STARTING ROLLUP: canary traffic 10% -> v3.8.0 (nodes: canary-01..03)

jordan: Rolling criteria: hold for 15m steady-state. Rollback triggers (pre-agreed):
- errors (5xx) increase by >2pp over baseline for 5m
- p95 latency increase >200ms sustained for 5m
- any customer-facing data loss or critical webhook failure
If any trigger hits, oncall runs immediate rollback.

sre-oncall: I have monitoring and runbooks open. Will escalate at trigger threshold.

kat: Also note feature flag gated for 75% of requests; we keep it off for EU until canary proves stable.

alex: Two operational notes: (1) prefix KV cache warmup script is pre-seeded on canary nodes. (2) we disabled aggressive batching for first 30m to reduce variance.

maria: All right. I approve the canary with those thresholds. If we hit p95 regression we will cut traffic back to 0% and investigate.

sam: Starting canary ramp script now — tailing logs. snippet:```bash
./rollout --target canary --artifact v3.8.0 --traffic 10
```

deploy-bot: canary: node canary-01 reported startup OK, model load 62s, kv-cache primed
deploy-bot: canary: healthcheck OK (200), latency p50=48ms p95=132ms, 5xx=0.05%

jordan: good numbers. hold for 15m, then we'll consider 50% if still green. Remember: no manual pin changes unless owners + release manager approve.

sam: +1. I'll post a short playbook for rollback steps in this thread if we need it.

sre-oncall: Noted. I have alert paging on for the thresholds.

maria: minor nit — add to the release notes that customers behind older SDK v2 may see 401 briefly; we already have the mitigation in place.

kat: Done. Added line to release-notes and one-liner to post in #general after GA.

jordan: If everything stays green at +15m, we do 50% and then GA after an additional 30m quiet window. Any objections?

alex: no objections.

sam: no objections, proceeding.

deploy-bot: RAMP UPDATE: canary -> 10% steady at 15m check
deploy-bot: RAMP UPDATE: increasing to 50% (scheduled, will notify on completion)

deploy-bot: RAMP COMPLETE: 50% -> v3.8.0 (timestamp=1738888938)

jordan: 50% looks stable. final GA window will start in 30m unless we see alerts. thanks all — leaving this thread open for final signoff. :thumbsup:

sam: final signoff pending the 30m quiet window. I'll post GA notice when done.

maria: thanks team.

kat: :rocket:
